description: Updates for every pinned dependency: Python (uv.lock), the UI and the website (npm), base images by digest, Debian packages in the Dockerfile and GitHub Actions by commit. A release waits two weeks before it is proposed. The project's own image in the compose templates is left alone.

packageRules.description: A new Python or Node.js version changes the runtime for all code and dependencies at once: it waits for approval on the dependency dashboard and is then done as one change (base image, required version, lint and type check targets). Digests and patches come as usual.

customManagers.description: Debian packages pinned in the Dockerfile: apt-get install name=version
